name: backprop
description: Backpropagation: one training epoch (forward + backprop) of a 3-layer fully-connected net (n_input -> 16 -> 1).

output_parser.comment: Each line is '<index>\t<value>'; compare column 2 (adjusted input->hidden weight, row-major over (n_input+1)x17) by index.

tolerance.comment: Measured reduction-reorder relative diff on this output is exactly 0 (ascending vs reversed vs pairwise-tree, sizes 8..65536) because the input->hidden sum saturates the sigmoid so the weight adjustment is ~0 and falls below the output float32 ULP; an independent float32 reimplementation matched the golden to max abs 5e-7. rtol=1e-3/atol=1e-4 generously absorbs benign float/exp drift while still catching real RNG/indexing/squash/delta logic bugs. NOTE: at n_input=65536 the network saturates, so the correct adjusted weights equal the initial random weights to float precision (a Rodinia property, not a port bug) - see ALGORITHM.md.

build.comment: Correctness build disables FMA contraction to match the CPU serial bit-closely; perf build uses defaults (FMA on) for realistic timing.
